name: Leah
overview: Leah, the elder daughter of Laban, was given in marriage to Jacob through her father's deception, as Jacob had intended to marry her younger sister Rachel. Despite being unloved by Jacob, the Lord saw Leah's plight and blessed her with children, opening her womb while Rachel remained barren. Leah's role as a wife to Jacob and mother to several of his children positions her as a foundational figure in the building of the house of Israel.
